items.title: John Joseph Interview, 1962-01-18
items.q: I know the bass player. That's Foster on bass. You know. Dude's brother.

ctx.x: Well he's still alive. The violin player lives up front of town. Uptown. He live up town yet?
Front of town. The violin player. I know the bass player. That's Foster on bass. You know. Dude's brother.

And Stone and Chiff. But we don't know the violin players. That's a myth. Well it'll come here. I know his name is John. John? I wonder if he's any kind of John Robichoe. No. It's the only John I can think of. Yeah. Is he right handed or left handed?
